weapons.short_description: Fast kinetic fire that scales through repeated hits.
weapons.long_description: A reliable single-target module with high firing frequency. Pierce, bounce, and fire-rate upgrades turn it into lane coverage.

weapons.short_description: Heavy shells that punish clustered enemies.
weapons.long_description: Slow, powerful area shots create upgrade routes through splash, burn, stun, and wind reactions.
The beam attacks continuously and rewards electric chains, status effects, and reaction-focused builds.

weapons.short_description: Control fire that slows the lane.
weapons.long_description: Lower immediate damage creates time for the tower. Freeze, shatter, and electric reactions complete the control route.
The railgun deletes high-health threats but needs pierce, bounce, or area support to solve dense waves.
